beats.text: Every essay I wrote came back covered in red ink.
Mrs. D'Souza. Class 9. I hated that red pen.
Last year I sent her my first published book.
She posted it back. Every page marked. In red.
On the last page: "Finally. No corrections. Proud of you."

end.text: Tag the teacher who made you a writer
